project.name: IXOR v21 live evidence project-health graph

obligations.description: The accepted operating configuration must not structurally interfere with the conveyor or required product-flow envelope.
The application roller must reach the intended bottle contact condition under verified travel and restraint geometry.
Application geometry, peel-edge relation, bottle restraint, clearances, and product flow are mechanically coherent enough to advance beyond fit-check.
v21 is acceptable as an operating-configuration candidate rather than only an AR60/carriage fit-check.

acceptance_blockers.description: Application geometry, peel-edge relation, bottle restraint, clearances, and product flow are mechanically coherent enough to advance beyond fit-check.
The application roller must reach the intended bottle contact condition under verified travel and restraint geometry.
Bottle support/restraint geometry is defined for the intended labeling condition.
The accepted operating configuration must not structurally interfere with the conveyor or required product-flow envelope.
Deterministic peel-edge relationship to the bottle at the intended application station.
Bottle entry, application, release, and downstream flow mechanics are deterministically established.
Required operating contact position is reachable within verified AR carriage travel.
Intended mechanically valid AR60/carriage application-station transform relative to the bottle path, IXOR peel edge, and mounting structure.

Verified usable AR carriage travel along the mechanically relevant adjustment axis.

risk_footprints.description: Intended mechanically valid AR60/carriage application-station transform relative to the bottle path, IXOR peel edge, and mounting structure.
